items.title: 32.1 Therapeutic index aur therapeutic window (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to therapeutic index and window (PDF 233).

blocks.text: Pharmacology woh ilm hai jo batata hai ke dawa kya karti hai aur kin hifazati hudood mein kaam karti hai. Har dawa mumkina taur par zehr ho sakti hai; farq khurak (dose) ka hai. Therapeutic window aur therapeutic index yeh samajhne ke markazi khayalat hain ke dawa kitni mehfooz aur mo'assar hai, aur yeh doctors ko mareez ke liye dawa ki sahi miqdar tay karne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Kyun kaha jata hai ke har dawa zehr ho sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke asar khurak par munhasir hai: kisi bhi dawa ki zyada khurak nuqsan-deh ho sakti hai.

items: Pharmacology: dawa kya karti aur us ki hifazati hudood.
Khurak dawa aur zehr ka farq tay karti.
